submission.justification: Absorber-F1 with a 4 mm plate thickness provides the best energy resolution (3.177%) at 100 GeV among all tested combinations, fulfilling the primary goal. The selected thickness is compliant with the 2-10 mm constraint, and F1 is one of the candidate materials. Maintenance requirements for hands-on access are also met according to project documentation for this material and geometry.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
Calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: Project documents state Absorber-F1 design allows hands-on access.
Selected thickness is 4 mm, within specified range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: F1 4mm achieves the best recorded resolution of 3.177% at 100 GeV.
